headline: Gannon beat the side that beat Slippery Rock
dek: Frostburg State came to Gannon having won at Slippery Rock, and left beaten, extending a Gannon run without defeat that reaches back to the first week of September. Across all their matches they have won seventeen times and been beaten twice, conceding fourteen goals.
displaced_by: The standing dek's goals-conceded figure for Gannon is no longer true after the Frostburg State match. Gannon beating the side that beat Slippery Rock is now the story.
